name: Sekijima Miki
source: The middle triplet who is quite motherly. Her cooking skills are outstanding and she always makes meals for the protagonist when their parents are away. Because she has an "average" body, she doesn't have any kind of complex about it unlike [url=/c60964]Mika[/url].
